data.investment_objective: The objective of the Scheme is to invest in companies whose securities are included in Nifty Pharma Index and subject to tracking errors, to endeavor to achieve the returns of the above index. This would be done by investing in all the stocks comprising the Nifty Pharma Index in the same weightage that they represent in Nifty Pharma Index. However, there is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the scheme shall be achieved.
